method: Separate post-draft assessment under writing-naturalness.md and the drmTMB prose-style-review checklist; report claims compared with source, tests, and captured check outputs.
coverage: Whole after-task report, all 12 required sections.
score_reason: The report names the exact model, support boundary, checks, and remaining work. Its regular structure follows the required project template, while the details are specific to this implementation slice.
confidence_reason: The implementation claims and check outcomes were compared with current source and command results. The style score is an editorial judgment without calibrated human controls.

examples.cue: The focused result gives the count and failure state before describing wider checks.
examples.impact: Readers can distinguish the direct test evidence from documentation checks.
examples.quote: The focused test passed 17 expectations with no failures, warnings, or skips

science_gate_reason: The model equation and covariance were reviewed against the implementation and the independent marginal-likelihood test; inference claims stop at point recovery and workflow checks.
facts_gate_reason: The route, exact test count, render, pkgdown check, warnings, and scope limits were compared with source, output, and status inventory.
references_gate_reason: The report makes no external citation claims.
calibration_status: No human-labelled calibration control was reviewed; this is an informal self-assessment.
